data.gender_notes: Tess is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, 'Tessa' means to offer or yield. In Greek, it is derived from 'Thea' meaning 'Goddess'. Combined, Tess can be interpreted as God's Harvester. The name Tess carries the meaning “God's Harvester” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tess usually hope their child will grow to embody god's harvester and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication to spiritual growth and service to others.
data.etymology: Tess belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Harvester.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tess total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: טס
in_hebrew.meaning: השם טס הוא צורה מקוצרת של תשועה שמשמעותו ישועה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם טס הוא צורה מקוצרת של תשועה, שמשמעותו ישועה או הצלה. הוא נגזר מהשורש העברי ישע, שפירושו להציל או להושיע. בתנך, תשועה היא אחת הדמויות המרכזיות, והיא ידועה כאשתו של יהודה ואם פר וזרע. השם טס הוא גם קיצור של שמות הנגזרים מתשועה, כמו תשועה או תשיה. השם טס הוא שם נפוץ בקרב יהודים ונוצרים כאחד, והוא נושא משמעות רבה בהקשר הדתי והתרבותי.

in_greek.name: Τες
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Τες είναι μια σύντομη μορφή του Θεοδόσιος που σημαίνει Θεός δεδομένος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τες είναι μια σύντομη μορφή του Θεοδόσιος, που σημαίνει Θεός δεδομένος ή Θεός της σωτηρίας. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το Θεοδόσιος ήταν ένα όνομα πολύ δημοφιλές κατά την εποχή του Βυζαντίου, και ήταν γνωστό ως το όνομα πολλών αγίων και αυτοκρατόρων. Το όνομα Τες είναι επίσης πιθανό να συνδέεται με το ελληνικό όνομα Θεσσαλονίκη, που σημαίνει θερμός και νίκη. Στην Εκκλησία Ορθόδοξης, το όνομα Τες θεωρείται σύμβολο της σωτηρίας και της πίστης στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Tess
in_latin.meaning: The name Tess is a short form of Theresa meaning harvester or reaper
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Tess is a short form of Theresa, which is derived from the Greek name Θερεσια (Theresia), meaning harvester or reaper. In Christian tradition, Saint Theresa of Avila was a prominent Spanish mystic and writer, and her name has been associated with devotion, prayer, and spiritual growth. The name Tess has been adopted in many cultures, and is often seen as a symbol of diligence, hard work, and spiritual dedication.

in_english.name: Tess
in_english.meaning: Tess means a harvester or reaper, derived from Theresa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tess is a shortened form of Theresa, which originates from the Greek name Θερεσια (Theresia). It means harvester or reaper, and is associated with Saint Theresa of Avila, a renowned Spanish mystic and writer. In Christian tradition, the name Tess symbolizes diligence, hard work, and spiritual devotion. It has been adopted in many cultures, and is often given to girls born into Christian families who value its rich spiritual heritage and historical significance.
